name: KinCony KC868-AP
description: KinCony KC868-AP reference board. I2C addresses verified by bus scan on 2026-11-19: PCA9685 at 0x40 (not 0x00 as pinmap claimed), PCF8574 DI1-8 at 0x22, PCF8574 DI9-16 at 0x21 (both match pinmap). Unknown device at 0x70. PCA9685 all 16 channels verified writable. Relay GPIOs 13/2 verified toggle. PCF8574 inputs 0x21/0x22 verified readable. GPIO0/34/35 verified readable. Relay polarity, Ethernet clock mode, RS485 direction remain unverified.
